- Ronald is busy during 9:00–9:30, 10:00–11:30, 12:30–14:00, and 14:30–17:00.

- Ashley is free from 12:00 to 12:30 (between her 11:00–12:00 and 12:30–13:00 meetings).
- Ronald is free from 11:30 to 12:30 (so 12:00–12:30 is included).
- Larry is free from 12:00 to 13:00.
